title: Alicia A NDE 7917
content: In June of 2001, I had been working at Dunkin Donuts as the manager. I had not felt right for a few days. On the fourth or fifth day of feeling sick, I had come downstairs and somehow lost consciousness on the kitchen floor. It was around 8:30 am or so when I was found by my grandmother. She got me up off the floor, and I can remember her getting me into the emergency room. They rushed me in to a room. I can recall an IV bag. They were squeezing the fluid into my vein. I felt drops of the water hitting my face. The last thing I remember is that I could hear them talking and then I heard nothing. My organs shut down because I was very septic. From what my grandmother said, they had to use the paddles to bring me back to life. I was in the emergency room from around 9:00 am until 6:00 pm, until I was stable enough to be moved to the intensive care unit where I spent 4 days. After that, I spent 3 days on the recovery floor. During the time I was in the emergency room, I was taken into the universe. I was literally in space. There were thousands of energies with me and we were all watching the earth turn itself inside out. It looked like a black hole does, but was red like flowing lava. There was one larger energy with us, I can not say this was God, as I didn't ask the energy's name. But as I witnessed the earth, I looked around and asked, 'Where is my family?' The large energy said, 'Who is here is who is meant to be here.' The fear and panic I was feeling immediately went away and I felt very calm. Then I asked, 'Why is this happening?' Again, the larger energy replied, 'This is what has to be done.'

arrival.other_being_detail: Narrator reports being "literally in space" with "thousands of energies" and "one larger energy" whose name/identity was not asked (not identified as God).

environment.environment_other_detail: Described as being "literally in space" / "in the universe"; watching Earth turn "inside out" like a red, lava-like black hole.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Sepsis; narrator states organs shut down and grandmother reported paddles were used to bring her back.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Presence of many 'energies' and one larger energy; observation of Earth turning inside out.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: No OBE/tunnel/boundary described; experience begins with being 'taken into the universe' and observing Earth with many energies and a larger energy communicating.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Watching the Earth "turn itself inside out" like a red, lava-like black hole while in space with "thousands of energies."
unique_elements.notable_quotes: "Where is my family?" / "Who is here is who is meant to be here." and "Why is this happening?" / "This is what has to be done."
